pop.description: Pop music emphasizes catchy melodies, hooks, and broad appeal. Modern pop blends electronic production with vocal-driven songwriting.

era_notes.1980s: Synth-driven, dance-oriented pop defined by artists like Michael Jackson and Madonna.
era_notes.2020s: Genre-blending pop with trap influences, autotune, and streaming-optimized production.

lofi.description: Lo-fi hip hop and chillhop use dusty samples, vinyl crackle, and mellow beats. Popular for studying, relaxation, and background listening.

era_notes.2020s: Exploded via YouTube livestreams and Spotify playlists. Artists like LoRoom create ambient, loop-based tracks.

rock.description: Guitar-driven music with strong rhythms and vocal intensity. Spans from classic rock to modern alternative and post-hardcore.

era_notes.2010s: Post-rock and indie rock blended with electronic elements. Stadium rock gave way to festival-oriented sound.

alt-rock.description: Alternative rock blends punk energy with melodic songwriting. Known for emotional depth, introspective lyrics, and genre-blending experimentation.

era_notes.2000s: Post-hardcore and emo-adjacent alt-rock defined by bands like Cold, AFI, and Chevelle. Heavy guitars with vulnerable, emotional vocals.

ambient.description: Ambient music prioritizes atmosphere and texture over melody or rhythm. Creates immersive soundscapes for contemplation or relaxation.

era_notes.2010s: Digital ambient expanded with synthesizers and field recordings. Artists like Orbit Bloom create cosmic, spacey textures.

jazz.description: Jazz emphasizes improvisation, swing rhythms, and harmonic complexity. Modern jazz blends with soul, hip-hop, and electronic influences.

era_notes.2010s: Neo-soul and jazz fusion gained streaming popularity. Café jazz and acoustic jazz became staples of mood playlists.

synthwave.description: Retro-futuristic electronic music inspired by 1980s synthesizers, film scores, and video game soundtracks. Heavy on nostalgia and atmosphere.

era_notes.2020s: Synthwave crossed into mainstream via TV shows like Stranger Things and video game soundtracks.

indie pop.description: Independent pop music with DIY aesthetics, jangly guitars, and optimistic melodies. Less polished than mainstream pop, more personal.

era_notes.2020s: Bedroom pop and indie pop became dominant on TikTok and Spotify Discover playlists.

r&b.description: Rhythm and blues blends soulful vocals with groove-oriented production. Modern R&B incorporates hip-hop beats and electronic textures.

era_notes.1990s: Neo-soul golden era defined by Lauryn Hill, Erykah Badu, and D'Angelo. The Miseducation of Lauryn Hill (1998) redefined what R&B could be.

reggaeton.description: Latin urban music built on dembow rhythms, Caribbean influences, and danceable beats. Dominates global streaming charts.

era_notes.2020s: Bad Bunny became the most-streamed artist globally, proving reggaeton's worldwide dominance.

corridos.description: Mexican regional music blending traditional corrido storytelling with modern trap and urban production. Corridos tumbados modernized the genre.

era_notes.2020s: Fuerza Regida and Peso Pluma brought corridos tumbados to Billboard charts, fusing regional Mexican with trap beats.

hip-hop.description: Rhythm-driven music built on beats, sampling, and lyrical flow. Ranges from conscious rap to trap to boom-bap.

era_notes.1990s: Golden age of conscious hip-hop. Lauryn Hill, Nas, and Wu-Tang Clan pushed lyrical and production boundaries.

prog-rock.description: Progressive rock features complex time signatures, virtuosic musicianship, and genre-defying compositions. Often blends rock with jazz, classical, and math-rock.

era_notes.2010s: Modern prog bands like Thank You Scientist and Haken brought jazz-fusion energy to progressive rock, creating technically demanding but accessible music.

happy.description: Upbeat, positive, feel-good music that lifts the listener's spirits.

chill.description: Relaxed, low-energy music for unwinding or background listening.

intense.description: High-energy, driving music with urgency and power.

melancholic.description: Sad, reflective music with emotional weight and introspective depth.

heartbreak.description: Music about loss, longing, and emotional pain. Raw vulnerability.

dark.description: Moody, atmospheric music with shadowy tones and brooding energy.

hype.description: Get-pumped, party-ready music designed to energize and excite.

romantic.description: Tender, love-inspired music with warmth and emotional intimacy.

nostalgic.description: Music that evokes memories, past eras, and bittersweet reflection.

focused.description: Concentration-friendly music with minimal distractions. Often instrumental.

energetic.description: High-tempo, driving music that makes you want to move.

relaxed.description: Easy-going, calm music without tension or urgency.

moody.description: Atmospheric music with emotional complexity and shifting tones.

confident.description: Self-assured, bold music that projects strength and swagger.

Lauryn Hill.bio: Legendary singer-rapper who defined neo-soul with The Miseducation of Lauryn Hill (1998). Known for blending hip-hop, R&B, and reggae with deeply personal lyrics about love, identity, and social justice.
Lauryn Hill.signature_style: Raw vocal power, acoustic guitar over hip-hop beats, confessional storytelling

Cold.bio: Post-grunge/alt-rock band from Jacksonville, FL. Known for emotionally heavy, guitar-driven songs exploring pain, isolation, and vulnerability.
Cold.signature_style: Atmospheric guitars, Scooter Ward's haunting vocals, slow-burn emotional intensity

AFI.bio: Evolving punk/alt-rock band that moved from hardcore punk to atmospheric, darkwave-influenced rock. Known for dramatic, theatrical performances.
AFI.signature_style: Dark melodic hooks, Davey Havok's dynamic vocals, gothic-tinged alt-rock

Bad Bunny & Yaviah.bio: Bad Bunny is the most-streamed artist globally and a pioneer of Latin trap and reggaeton. Yaviah is a Puerto Rican reggaeton veteran.
Bad Bunny & Yaviah.signature_style: Dembow rhythms, genre-blending production, bilingual vocals

Fuerza Regida.bio: Tijuana-born group at the forefront of corridos tumbados — a fusion of traditional Mexican corridos with modern trap production.
Fuerza Regida.signature_style: Requinto guitar meets 808 bass, aggressive delivery, street storytelling

Michael Jackson.bio: The King of Pop. Defined pop music across the 1980s and 1990s with unmatched artistry in songwriting, dancing, and visual storytelling.
Michael Jackson.signature_style: Smooth vocals, groove-heavy production, cinematic music videos

Thank You Scientist.bio: Progressive rock/jazz fusion band from New Jersey known for technically demanding compositions featuring brass, strings, and complex time signatures.
Thank You Scientist.signature_style: Math-rock precision, jazz improvisation, controlled chaos

content_based_filtering.description: A recommendation approach that matches items to users based on item features (genre, mood, energy) rather than user behavior. Works well with small catalogs but can't discover unexpected preferences.
content_based_filtering.strengths: No cold-start problem for items, transparent reasoning, works with small datasets
content_based_filtering.weaknesses: Can create filter bubbles, can't capture social trends, limited to known features

mood_similarity.description: Related moods should receive partial credit instead of zero. For example, 'heartbreak' and 'melancholic' are emotionally adjacent and should score partial matches.
mood_similarity.example: A user wanting 'heartbreak' mood should get partial credit for 'melancholic' songs (e.g., +2.0 instead of +3.0) rather than zero.

filter_bubbles.description: When recommendation systems only show content similar to what a user already likes, they create an echo chamber that limits discovery. Diversity penalties help break filter bubbles.
filter_bubbles.real_world: Spotify's Discover Weekly algorithm intentionally includes some unfamiliar genres to prevent total filter bubbles.

hybrid_recommender.description: Combines content-based filtering (matching features) with collaborative signals (popularity, play counts) for better recommendations than either approach alone.
hybrid_recommender.example: Using both mood-matching scores AND popularity data to rank songs.
